name: lever outdoor seated leg press
description: Seated leg press on an outdoor lever machine, pushing the pads away with your legs to train thighs and glutes.
instructions: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Place your feet on the footplates, shoulder-width apart.
Push the plates away until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees at the top.
Bend your knees to return slowly and repeat.
